EA Mech tower offense + nice graphics + potential = Gundam mixed with LoL/Dota2. Four player co-op with people/AI. Unlock and upgrade mechs as you lvl. Gain skills/passives. Looking forward to updates.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35180752-3-point-play/] Follow our curator for similar games [/url][/h1]

Good points😍
Good graphics and controls.
The game can be played comfortably as it does not require much aim.

The robot design is the coolest.

You can customize the game
You can customize it to your liking.
There is a challenging element to the game.
Bad points😱
The map would be better if it was easier to see where your allies are.
The tutorial was a little confusing.

I have played for about 6 hours and here are my impressions.
It's hard to understand the function of each object.
I need a tutorial though.
With 4 people it's challenging and interesting!

PVP Network ERRORS all the time, rarely do you get to play to completion
MULTIPLAYER Network ERRORS all the time, Never have been able to complete the 5 mission , not once. 

Want to play a game with multiple boots off the server except in single player mode, than this Game is For YOU !

A lot of good foundation in this game, but it could be so much more. It has the bones of a moba with mechs but they don’t really do anything outside of tower defense. I’d say that it’s worth the price right now, but you’ll notice what it could be when you play a little bit.

I know there are a lot of unfavorable comments, but
I've never had a communication error.
It's fun to play with 4 players and boisterous!

It's difficult, but if you divide up the roles well, you'll be surprised how efficient you can be.
Also, the phantom mode is fun!

I actually quite like this game and the fact its early access means there's definitely going to be new updates. If your expecting a fast based bullet hell then this ain't for you chef. I don't really have any suggestions as to what can be worked upon, but I'll be sure to comment as I continue playing, I'd like to see where this game goes. ;)


Edit: So after playing it a bit more I can suggest a few things. Number 1, the cool down on some of the VA's needs to be reduced.

Suggestions:
 Disclaimer I'm not exactly a pro at these kinds of things so if you think something from this list needs to be changed then feel free to comment :)

TRIGLAV: 
             
1st ability CD needs to be reduced from 66 seconds to 25.
            
2nd ability CD needs to be reduced from 75 seconds to 20.
             
3rd ability CD needs to be reduced from 20 seconds to 14.
             
4th ability's CD seems reasonable considering its damage.


BLACK ROSE:
                    
1st ability's CD seems reasonable.
                    
2nd ability CD needs to be reduced to 20 seconds.
                    
3rd ability CD needs to be reduced to 18 seconds and It seems the healing you get from this ability depends on how many enemy's you hit, I think the healing you gain from this attack should scale with your damage.

4th ability CD seems reasonable.


GRIMHILDE:

1st ability CD needs to be reduced to 10 seconds.

2nd ability CD needs to be reduced to 15 seconds.

3rd ability CD needs to be reduced to 20 seconds.

4th ability CD seems reasonable.


PIED PIPER:

1st ability CD needs to be reduced to 15 seconds.

2nd ability CD needs to be reduced to 15 seconds.

3rd ability CD needs to be reduced to 25 seconds.

4th ability CD needs to be reduced to 190 seconds considering its effect.


I also think you need to add new maps to spice it up a bit, and if you do add different maps please add different soundtracks for each different map. The ally AI also need to be tweaked a bit so that they don't go running in head first and getting scraped (teach them how to strafe please -_- ).

Also when I saw the adjust effect system for the first time it reminded me of Payday 2's Crime Spree mode, so I think it would be amazing if you added a mode similar to that game.







If you do add that mode here's a name for it.
VOID STREAM, Trademarked

There's a good game here but not as a tower defense game. If this was the groundwork for a MOBA I'd be rather excited but as it is, it's a boring tower defense game. 

Neither is it fast and engaging or slow and tactical. This could work if there was a competitive multilayer element where you could summon troops and fight for objectives against a smart ( player ) foe.

On the other hand you could try speeding up the game and make it more of a visual spectacle and pay more like Zone of Enders or daemon x machina with dynamic co-operative missions. 
Projectiles could also act like they do in the Nier franchise but that's just a personal preference. 

What I do like is is the art style and how the UI looks ( for the most part ). The voice acting is also nice but albeit overwhelming during missions. I really think There's good game here, but not in its current iteration.

This game has potential, but right now it is VERY early access; and not worth the current price of admission.

However, I can see this becoming worth the price down the road. Should the developers keep with it, and not give up. Because the spark is here, the form is here. It just needs a chunk of refinement done to it, as they add-in more content.

As someone who's played a lot of early access titles, this is a better start than most. But should have been listed only at around $15 - $20 USD, as the amount of content to it is very little at the moment. Then raise it as they get to a higher build of the game.

Cool concept but i don't think i can recommend this yet. Very little content for the steep price so will be refunding. The CPU is utterly braindead and is a glorified minion from League of Legends. Runs to the tower, sits stationary and dies. Not to mention that you have to buy VA's (Mech suit) for the CPU's with in game currency each time to join you on solo play. Speaking of LoL, this game is pretty much a MOBA without human opposition, i fail to see how this is a "Tower Defence" game. I may pick this up later and change this to a positive recommendation when the game has had some work on it. Good luck devs :)

It honestly saddens me to write this a bit; I want to cheer on Hexadrive in their first proper solo effort; there's clearly a lot of production value here, it's all very pretty and stylish; and the implication if I'm understanding all this correctly seems to be that this is the 1st part of a plan to make a MOBA called "Star League"; a kind of gameplay foundation which makes a lot of sense when you know that context; you go out to defend against waves of enemies coming through lanes to destroy your core, you push up to fight turrets to eventually take down the enemies core (in the form of a boss fight), and the combat is a big 3d interpretation of moba combat with long skill cooldowns, an emphasis on energy (mana) management and even an item shop when you warp back to base...
If this was a moba it'd be a unique starting point... but it isn't a moba, it's a PvE "Tower Offense" thing and... maybe the later missions resolve the issues listed in the rest of this review but, in all honesty the 1st hour of this game has been nothing but a slog to get through...

 The onboarding is abysmal with some text-box tutorials that honestly don't really teach you how to play the game that much while also saying a lot about using your ingame currency for per-session upgrades and the fact you need to use that currency to buy the mechs for AI teammates in a session....it's a bit weird but once you get in-game and finally start playing it....it becomes incredibly tedious. Well I say that, the gameplay itself is actually okay, a neat, if a little stiff, take on moba combat and cooldowns and shopping for items in a 3d space where the concepts of up and down are also a thing.

However there are 3 Central issues that basically ruin anything this game is doing alright:
1: The rate of getting resources to buy items is glacial: at least in the 1st maps I played that fun feeling of fighting enemies, getting resources, and powering up your character is just nothing which stops you from feeling any substantial sense of strategy or growth or basically anything at all. It doesn't even seem like the enemies are dropping the resources for your shop or at least not at any substantial rate, they are however dropping cubes that you use to power up a passive rate for your shopping resources...it's a very unsatisfying system.

2: The enemy cannot handle the concept of strafing: be it minion, boss, or turret, strafe and shoot and you'll win any fight eventually; and because you don't spawn minions naturally (although yes you can go to a mysterious hidden poll that isn't on the map nor really explained and it will spawn 1 small wave of minions) this means, at least as far as the turrets are concerned, this behaviour is somewhat intentional otherwise the game would be impossible; so most of your game is just hold strafe and left-click until eventually the high health turret dies. It works on the boss too, your only danger is time investment....this is beyond boring.

3: The balancing between single-player and multiplayer is abysmal: Because of the weird "buying AI" thing that kinda discourages you to and with the game making no real mention of it, on my first match I went into single player alone, and it was a slow slog of just waiting to eventually kill these turrets that feared the concept of the a and d keys. It took a lot of time, eventually by the end I had some starter items, I was high enough level to have an ultimate ability, and slowly but surely over the course of about 30-40 minutes or so killed the boss with incredible strafing skills. Then I went in a multiplayer match with 1 other human and 2 AIs. It took 8 minutes, we never had to go back for items; we just strafe killed every turret and the end boss and we were done before we even got our ultimates....Both matches were not fun for very different reasons.

Look I want to cheer on Star League if and when they make it; I mean there's a cool traditional moba meets flying anime mech hybrid here that could be really cool to see one day, maybe not necessarily my thing but I'd be happy to see it and give it a go... But this thing, this format....it just isn't fun. It's clearly not low effort, I mean playing that 1st map multiple times had different layouts and stuff and that was kinda cool but....it was so boring......it was insufferably boring on my own, and then immediately tediously simple with others... Sorry Hexadrive, I want to cheer you on but I cannot in any good conscience recommend this game to basically anyone, at least not in this form, sorry :(
